reviews.author: Ye Ye
reviews.title: Good food for big fish
reviews.body: The food comes well-sealed. I wish it had a bit longer shelf life though. It has a natural look and smell. The larvae are too big for common community fish and you have the crumble the food for them. Still, this is not staple food for small omnivore fish; most play with it or spit out before accepting as the last resort. On the other hand, these are a great treat for large carnivores (cichlids and catfish in my case) that can gulp them down. Bluegills go crazy for them and now I am wondering if these are the same as waxworms.

Now slowly they are getting accustomed
